snippet.title: Misguided Remastered - Teaser
snippet.description:
Misguided: Remastered will launch on February 20, 2025, for Android, with iOS coming soon.

This 3D action-horror game offers an enhanced experience with updated storylines, improved graphics, and revamped animations. The newly designed cutscenes add deeper immersion as you follow Silvia's journey through a mysterious, otherworldly realm.

Get ready for an unforgettable adventure filled with secrets and terrifying mystical creatures.
#MisguidedRemastered #IndieGame #HorrorGamee
